event.structureHelp.ua: UA Event (uaevent): interactive event using the classic eventCategory / eventAction / eventLabel structure. Use it when the interaction should count toward user engagement (for example clicks or form submits).
event.structureHelp.ni: NI Event (nievent): Non-Interaction Event. Uses the same field structure as UA Event, but does not affect bounce rate. Ideal for impressions, loads, or background measurements.
event.structureHelp.custom: Custom: freely define the event field value (for example purchase, generate_lead, or video_start) while keeping the remaining parameters.
